tei:div.tei:p: "$ (331)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro chos spyod kyi ngag 'don zung 'jug them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(332)༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ gang zhig srid dang zhi ba'i dngos po rnams// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i dbyings nyid du// rgyas gdab lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mchog /mngon par gsal ston dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// dus gsum rgyal dang rgyas sras kyi// 'jug ngogs bla na med pa yi// zab mo'i lam mchog 'dir gus rnams// sngon 'gro'i chos la 'bad pa rigs// de yang gang zag skal pa mchog dang ldan zhing dad mos dam tshig can gyis zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la rgyud snod rung du bya phyir thun mong sngon 'gro chos spyod kyi rim pa la lnga ste/ thog mar theg chen lam gyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa/ sdig sgrib bag chags sbyong byed rdor sems bskyed bzlas// tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs phyir maṇḍal mchod 'bul// thugs rjes rgyud grol smin byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas dang*/ thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor sogs kyi ngag 'don rnams thar chags bstar ba la/ dang po dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dkyus mthun tsam bca' sems rnal du phab nas// dag pa'i zhing khams yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ lha'i gzhal yas khang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i rgya khyon bkod legs de'i dbus su/ dpag bsam ljon pa rtsa ba brtan la yal ga dang lo 'dab me tog dang 'bras bu rgyas (333)pa'i steng du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi zla'i steng du/ ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku can la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad sprin ltar gtibs pa/ de la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor zhing*/ phyogs kyi sa gzhi la seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan re re gsal ba'i mdun du rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/

g.yas su 'phags pa 'jam dpal nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang*/ g.yon du mchog zung gnyis sogs nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ rgyab phyogs su chos dkon mchog dam pa'i chos gsung rab glegs bam gyi rnam pa/ gdan khri rnams kyi bar mtshams su ye shes chos skyong rnams dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa thams cad srung skyob kyi tshul du bzhugs par mos la/ de rnams kyi drung du rang dang lhan cig ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis skyabs yul rnams kyi yon tan dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang rigs drug sems can gyi sdug bsngal la snying rjes kun nas bslang ste thar pa'i gnas su drangs pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid (334)byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// de ltar tshogs zhing rnams la blo gtad ling bskyur gyis skyabs 'gro ci nus bya zhing*/ mthar/ bla ma dkon mchog rin po che rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis po thob par shog / ces brjod/ 'di skabs nyal pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

skyabs yul rnams ma bsdus thar bla ma'i sku'i mdun phyogs kyis gzhir pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid nyal bar mos te/ skyabs yul la mos gus sgom bzhin pas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o// zhar byung gi man ngag go /de nas gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la blos gzhig btang nas/ bdag gzhan thams cad bde ba ltar snang nyi tshe ba'i ngang nas/ sdug bsngal mtha' med khor mo yug tu spyod bzhin ba la yid skyo shas dang bcas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi'i don bsgom pa rang rgyud la ci 'drer bya zhing ngag tu/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi'o// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral (335)bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig / gang nus brjod mthar dge bsngo bcas bya/ gsum pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du// hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa// lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshul 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang padma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shri badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛḍo me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha ba/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaṃ/ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla zhing*/ sngags don dang mthun par gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ (336) mthar sngags phreng zhal nang bstan de las bdud rtsi babs sku gang rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar spros sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha rnams las bdud rtsi 'o rgyun ltar bab rang lus shel bum gang ba ltar/ nad gdon bag chags dri ma phyir lud par dmigs nas mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsum thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yab yum 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ gnas lugs skyong*/ bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog

/sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags kyang yang yang 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa maṇḍal ni/ dngos 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'di skabs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas la rten 'byung gi ched du gtsor bton dgos pas/ dkon mchog gi rten bkram pa'i drung*// mchod rdzas gang 'byor tshar du dngar ba dang*// maṇḍal rgyu rin po che las grub pa sogs gang rnyed dang*// dri bzang gi chu dang*/ 'bru sna la sogs pa bcas 'du byas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal med khang dang skyabs yul tshogs zhing rnams sngar ltar dmigs la/ bdag gzhan sems can gyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces dang*/ gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi// de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom nas// mig skyon med rnams rol par bcas pas steng du ni// blta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang po// khyod ni mgon (337)po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang*/ khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do// khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pa'am bsdu na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pas skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas lus kyi las su maṇḍal gyi tsham bu bkod/ yid kyi dmigs pa 'og gzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i gling bzhi ri rab 'khor yug dang bcas pa/ steng phyogs srid pa'i rtse mo man chad khams gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa lha dang mi'i dngos po bzang la gya noms bas go mtshams med cing phyur bur bkang ste bla med dkon mchog rnams la 'bul/

de'i rjes su bdag myur du sangs rgyas thob pa dang*/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams rtogs skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de dag gi skabs su ngag tu/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badzra re khe aḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba lang spyod/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas// rin chen maṇḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa// blo yis dmigs nas (338)bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes pa'am/ sa gzhi spos chus byung shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnams dag zhing la spyod par shog / ces brjod/ tshul des maṇḍal ci nus su 'bul/ thun 'jog khar/ mchod yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la gnyis su med par thim/ ngo bo skyong zhing dge bsngo sogs bya'o// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i dbus su/ seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan rang*/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ spros pa la dga' na phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ bsdu na yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa blos phul te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// sdig pa bshags so// dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo// mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o// skyabs su mchi'o// byang chub tu sems bskyed do// bla na med pa'i lam brten par bgyi'o// bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod cing don bsam/ bar 'dir spro na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs logs na yod pa rnams bya zhing bsdus (339) pa la dga' na ma byas kyang chog /nges par gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo chos rje dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// de bzhin du sbyar te/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma= skyabs mchog mtshungs med= 'dren mchog mtshungs med= thar pa'i lam ston= dngos grub 'byung gnas= ma rig mun sel bla ma rin po che= bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag rtse gcig sgrub pa nus par= sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar= /sgrub pa snying po nyams su longs par= /sgrub pa rab kyi mthar phyin par= /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs par= zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob par= nyams myong dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar=

zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa mthar phyin par= phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar rgyangs 'bod gsol 'debs snang ba 'gyur nges ci nus kyi mthar byin rlabs bsdu ba ni/ bla ma'i sku'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥrnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhugs/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ aḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros// rang gi snying gar thim yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ hoḥlas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/ chags rtog gi bag chags dag /bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin (340)rlabs zhugs/

dbang bzhi len par grangs gsog tshe/ gang gi bla ma'i sku sogs nas bskyar zhing mthar/ slar yang mos gus dung pa dang yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams bla ma nyid la thim/ de nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od zer bdud rtsi'i tshul du zhu ste rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag / dge bsngo sogs bya'o// gzhan yang*/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ sogs smon lam rnam dag ci rigs pa'ang brjod/ sngags lam gyi nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad bla ma'i byin rlabs kho nas lam tu byed dgos pas des na bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang bsten tshul/ mos gus dad pa'i phan yon sogs nges par byas nas nyams su ci nus len pa grub gnyis kyi rtsa ba mchog ste gal che'o// dmigs pa 'di'i yan lag nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la bla ma sku tshad tshon gang tsam dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal du bzhugs pa la mos gus dung nge ba'i ngang las gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o// de nas thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro la rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa lhan skyes nyid bsngags pas de'i bsgom tshul ni/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ārma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab pad zla nyi ma sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs can/

phyag sor rnams kha dog lnga pa/ sor tshigs rnams kha (341)dog gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan cing*/ me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can no// de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma dang*/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ dbu skra phyed grol ba'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang gnas su swā/ gtsug gtor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ lha sku gsal stong de la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag /de ltar bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ swā hā/ ci nus dang mthar/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ lha sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du sbyongs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sogs/ dben gsum ltos med bzhi ldan dang*/ dngos bzhi sor sdud bsam gtan dang*/ srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/ de dag ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'dod don gsol gdab ni/ lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// yid rnam rtog 'gyu ba so sor bcad// nyams 'od gsal rtags bcu rdzogs gyur nas// lam sor sdud 'byong par byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// yid rlung sems ngag rnams mi g.yo zhing*// nyams shes rab rtog dpyod dga' bde 'phel// lam bsam gtan 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin (342)chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// rtsa ro rkyang rlung bcu dbu mar tshud// nyams gtum mo 'bar bas haṃ yig zhu// lam srog rtsol 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// khams 'dzag med thig le dpral bar brtan// nyams zhu bde 'gyur med rgyud la skyes// lam 'dzin pa 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// lus rtsa 'dab bde chen thig les gang*// nyams phyag rgya gsum la mnga' brnyes po bde bas gang*// nyams spros pa med la dbang 'byor ba'i// lam ting 'dzin 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/
